promise: Let the Cheema lands (Lots 509 and 510) housing proposal be reviewed and negotiated.
quote: I support allowing a development proposal for Lots 509/ 510 for evaluation and negotiation.
how_to_check: Kept if he votes to let a Cheema lands proposal go forward for review, starting with the growth boundary step.

promise: Keep judging parking shortfalls for new buildings case by case, rather than banning them.
quote: Parking variances for new developments will need to be considered on a case-by-case basis
how_to_check: Watch his votes on parking variances: kept if he weighs each one on its merits instead of backing a blanket ban.

promise: Vote to spend developer parking payments on parking, not on bike and walking projects.
quote: The fees-in-lieu of parking stalls not provided should be considered for allocation to parking facilities in every case – and not necessarily directed to Active Transportation facilities.
how_to_check: Kept if he votes to send cash in lieu of parking into the off-street parking fund rather than the active transportation fund.

promise: Protect the few possible parkade sites, including north of Pemberton Avenue.
quote: The scarce potential locations for parkade facilities should be protected – including on the north side of Pemberton Avenue.
how_to_check: Kept if he votes against selling or rezoning possible parkade sites, such as land on the north side of Pemberton Avenue.

promise: Help bring back a downtown RCMP office.
quote: The District should help to facilitate the (re-)establishment of a Downtown RCMP office.
how_to_check: Kept if he moves or votes for steps that reopen an RCMP office downtown.

promise: Push to restart Crime Stoppers and Block Watch programs in Squamish.
quote: In addition, the District should examine the need for and facilitate the (re-)establishment of a Squamish CrimeStoppers organization and program, as well as Block Watch and similar neighbourhood-level programs.
how_to_check: Kept if the District helps set up or restart Crime Stoppers or Block Watch programs during this term.

promise: Push for a full update of the Parks and Recreation Master Plan alongside the Brennan Park work.
quote: The Brennan Park facilities planning task force currently at work and should be complimented by a comprehensive Parks & Recreation Master Plan update
how_to_check: Kept if council orders and funds an updated Parks and Recreation Master Plan.

promise: Seek a negotiated settlement with Woodfibre LNG that ends the court fights.
quote: I would go after a negotiated settlement and a real reset: a fair, predictable tax arrangement, a workable approach to worker accommodation, and community amenity contributions back on the table
how_to_check: Kept if she votes for a negotiated settlement with Woodfibre LNG that covers taxes and amenities and ends the lawsuits.

promise: Start considering the Cheema lands and Fast properties for housing on higher ground.
quote: We should start considering Fast Properties and Cheema Lands to avoid overbuilding on the floodplain.
how_to_check: Kept if she votes to let proposals for the Cheema lands or Fast properties be reviewed.

promise: Keep the six homes with no parking zoning switched off until frequent buses actually run.
quote: Keep the six-homes-no-parking zoning dormant until frequent buses are actually running.
how_to_check: Broken if she votes to turn on the six homes, no parking zoning before frequent bus service exists.

promise: Bring a permit for local people living in vehicles to a decision, with a date.
quote: I would bring it back with an actual decision and a date attached.
how_to_check: Kept if she brings a residents only vehicle permit to council for a vote with a set start date.

promise: Start a land bank now for worker housing and housing society projects.
quote: I also am for creating a land bank starting now for future employee housing, and housing society projects.
how_to_check: Kept if council sets up a land bank, or buys or reserves land, for worker and non-profit housing.

promise: Vote against any more parking variances, and rewrite the parking bylaw for Squamish.
quote: No more parking variances.  Review the bylaw and amend it to Squamish's needs.
how_to_check: Watch her votes on parking variances: kept if she votes against each request to cut required parking.

promise: Move restaurant patios off street parking and stop food trucks parking on Cleveland and 2nd.
quote: Right away, I would move restaurant seating off the street onto the sidewalk and stop food trucks from parking on Cleveland and 2nd between Victoria and Pemberton.
how_to_check: Kept if she moves a motion, and council acts, to take patios off parking stalls and bar food trucks from Cleveland and 2nd.

promise: Push council to set up a community parking committee right away.
quote: I will push Council to immediately strike a community Parking Committee made up of three downtown business owners, three homeowners from affected neighbourhoods, two Councillors, and the department head responsible for roads.
how_to_check: Kept if she moves early in the term to create this parking committee, and council sets it up.

promise: Direct staff to bring a budget with no property tax increase over last year.
quote: Direct Staff to bring a budget to Council that reflects zero increase over last year.
how_to_check: Kept if she moves or votes for a zero increase budget each year; watch whether the budget council adopts goes up.

promise: Send any big Brennan Park expansion to a referendum, not an alternate approval process.
quote: And if a big expansion is on the table, it goes to a referendum, not an alternate approval process.
how_to_check: Kept if she votes for a referendum, and against an alternate approval process, when council borrows for a big recreation expansion.

promise: Get simple permit applications decided in under 8 weeks, with published timelines.
quote: Streamline red tape so straightforward permit applications get a decision in under 8 weeks, with clear, published timelines businesses can count on.
how_to_check: Kept if the District publishes permit timelines and straightforward permits are decided in under 8 weeks.

promise: Finish a Tourism Master Plan in council's first year.
quote: Deliver a comprehensive Tourism Master Plan in year one of the next Council term to support a sustainable tourism economy under our "Hardwired for Adventure" brand.
how_to_check: Kept if council adopts a Tourism Master Plan by about November 2027.

promise: Get a stronger 10 year money deal and a 40 year agreement with Woodfibre LNG.
quote: I would like to see a more robust 10-year agreement. I would also pursue a thoughtful long-term MOU covering the 40-year operations period
how_to_check: Kept if the District signs a new 10 year tax agreement and a longer memorandum of understanding with Woodfibre LNG.

promise: Create a District job, held by a Squamish Nation member, to link the District and the Nation on Woodfibre LNG.
quote: Create a new District of Squamish liaison role, held by a Squamish Nation member, to serve as a conduit between the District and the Squamish Nation on Woodfibre LNG matters including regulation, local content and procurement.
how_to_check: Kept if the District creates and fills this liaison position.

promise: Create and carry out a Squamish poverty reduction and affordability plan.
quote: Develop and implement a Squamish Poverty Reduction and Affordability Strategy.
how_to_check: Kept if council adopts a Poverty Reduction and Affordability Strategy and funds steps from it.

promise: Vote no on letting new buildings have less parking than the rules require.
quote: I would vote no to parking variances.
how_to_check: Watch her votes on parking variances: kept if she votes against each request to cut required parking.

promise: Work to start building a second ice rink at Brennan Park in 2027.
quote: On Council, I would work toward shovels in the ground in 2027 for a second rink.
how_to_check: Kept if construction on a second ice rink starts in 2027; watch whether she votes for the funding and approvals to get there.

promise: Hold property taxes flat in 2027 and 2028, and win council votes to do it.
quote: Deliver a property tax freeze for 2027 and 2028, and build the council support needed to get it done.
how_to_check: Kept if the 2027 and 2028 budgets have a 0% increase in the municipal portion of residential property tax.

promise: Publish an easy online dashboard of big project budgets and timelines.
quote: Publish a public, plain-language dashboard tracking capital project budgets and timelines, keeping residents informed and Council accountable.
how_to_check: Kept if the District publishes a public dashboard of capital project budgets and timelines.

promise: Hold a yearly budget town hall, in person and online, before budget decisions.
quote: Host an annual Budget Town Hall, both in person and online, where the Mayor and Council present and explain the District's budget, increase transparency, answer residents' questions, and provide an opportunity for meaningful public input before budget decisions are made.
how_to_check: Kept if council holds a budget town hall each year, in person and online, before adopting the budget.

promise: Vote against rezoning business or industrial land for housing.
quote: Because of that, and despite the difficult choices involved, I would not support rezoning commercial or industrial lands for residential use.
how_to_check: Watch his votes: broken if he votes to rezone commercial or industrial land for housing.

promise: Push for regular testing and updating of Squamish's emergency plans.
quote: I will advocate for continual improvements of our emergency plans, regular testing and public communication, stronger coordination with regional and provincial partners, and investments that improve community safety and resilience.
how_to_check: Kept if the District regularly tests and updates its emergency plans, for wildfire and flood, and reports on them to the public.

promise: Push for developers to pay bigger community amenity contributions.
quote: I will advocate for responsible development, stronger Community Amenity Contributions, better infrastructure coordination, and public spaces and services that support residents of all ages
how_to_check: Kept if he votes to raise the community amenity contributions the District asks of developers.

promise: Push for a District run campground for people living in vehicles and for visitors.
quote: A better solution is to create a municipally operated campground that can serve both vehicle residents and visitors.
how_to_check: Kept if he moves or votes for the District to plan and open a campground with basic services for vehicle residents and visitors.

promise: Vote against letting new buildings have less parking than the rules require.
quote: I do not support parking variances that reduce the minimum parking requirements for new developments.
how_to_check: Watch his votes on parking variances: kept if he votes against each request to cut required parking.

promise: Make new developments provide public parking, held for public use forever.
quote: We need to leverage development to secure dedicated public parking, whether through municipal parkades or public stalls integrated within private developments, guaranteed in perpetuity via title covenants.
how_to_check: Kept if council approves projects that include public parking stalls protected by a covenant, or a parkade paid for by development.

promise: Keep short stay shopping parking downtown free, with time limits enforced.
quote: At the same time, commercial short-term parking should remain free to support downtown businesses, backed by consistent time-limit enforcement to ensure steady turnover for shoppers.
how_to_check: Broken if he votes to bring in paid parking for short stay shopping spots downtown.

promise: Push for a stronger community policing presence in Squamish.
quote: If elected, I would advocate for a stronger community policing presence in Squamish.
how_to_check: Kept if he moves or votes for more RCMP community policing, such as more officers on foot or a local office.

promise: Hold off on a big Brennan Park expansion until there is a clear plan to pay for it.
quote: My approach would be to maintain essential services, improve efficiency, phase upgrades responsibly, and avoid committing to major expansions until we have a clear funding strategy.
how_to_check: Broken if he votes to commit to a major Brennan Park expansion before council has adopted a funding plan for it.

promise: Push for a full review of the 10 year budget plan to find savings.
quote: If elected, I would push for a full review of the 10-year plan to identify savings, delay non-essential spending, improve efficiency, and make sure service increases are clearly tied to real community benefit.
how_to_check: Kept if he moves or votes for a full review of the 10 year financial plan that lists savings and delayed spending.

promise: Keep voting to carry out the town's Community Climate Action Plan.
quote: I support the 6 big moves of the town’s existing Community Climate Action Plan and would continue to vote in support of its implementation.
how_to_check: Kept if she votes for budget items and bylaws that carry out the Community Climate Action Plan.

promise: Vote against widening the growth boundary without a plan to pay for services and land for affordable housing.
quote: My current view for an OCP discussion is I would only support further expansion of the growth boundary if there is clear, feasible plan for financing and maintaining infrastructure and strong requirements for good planning and design and community benefits such as land for affordable housing.
how_to_check: Watch her votes on any boundary expansion (for example the Cheema lands): kept if she only supports one that comes with a funding plan and land for affordable housing.

promise: Support the Hearth and Home program and the Government Road supportive housing.
quote: I support Squamish’s participation in the Province’s Heart and Hearth program and the supportive housing development on Government Road.
how_to_check: Kept if she votes for the Hearth and Home project and the Government Road supportive housing when they come to council.

promise: Support a pilot program for people living in vehicles.
quote: I would support exploring pilot programs that allow us to test what works, learn from the results, and determine whether a broader program is feasible.
how_to_check: Kept if she votes for a pilot permit or parking program for people who live in their vehicles.

promise: Grow the District's housing fund and get land or homes from developers for non-profit housing.
quote: This includes negotiating with developers to provide land or units, building up our housing reserve fund, and supporting zoning relaxations and tax and fee waivers.
how_to_check: Kept if she votes to add money to the housing reserve fund, to fee waivers for non-profit housing, and for deals where developers give land or units.

promise: Update the parking rules for new downtown buildings to match how many cars people really have.
quote: I think it’s time to re-evaluate parking requirements for new Downtown development to make sure they reflect actual vehicle demand.
how_to_check: Kept if council reviews and updates the downtown parking requirements in the zoning bylaw during this term.

promise: Look at resident parking permits, time limits and paid parking downtown.
quote: We should also look at approaches that have worked in other communities, including resident permits, time limits and paid parking.
how_to_check: Kept if council studies or brings in resident permits, time limits or paid parking downtown.

promise: Not put a downtown parkade ahead of more pressing building needs.
quote: I’ve heard interest in a Downtown parking structure, but I would not prioritize that over more pressing capital needs.
how_to_check: Watch how she votes on a parkade: broken if she votes to fund a parkade ahead of other urgent capital projects.

promise: Speed up the Brennan Park task force so a replacement is designed and priced.
quote: Then, we need to expedite the work of the existing Brennan Park Task Force to design and begin costing out a replacement project.
how_to_check: Kept if council receives a design and cost estimate for a Brennan Park replacement during this term.

promise: Work to grow the network of safe bike routes for kids, families and seniors.
quote: I strongly support continued advocacy to build up our transit network, and work to expand Squamish’s safe cycling network for kids, families and seniors.
how_to_check: Kept if she votes to fund new protected bike routes and keeps pushing other governments for better transit.

promise: Put air and water monitoring stations around town to track Woodfibre LNG pollution.
quote: Install extensive air and water monitoring stations throughout the community to track potential impacts in real time
how_to_check: Kept if the District funds or secures community air and water monitoring stations that report results to the public.

promise: Pause approval of new developments unless they clearly make life better and more affordable.
quote: Pausing approval of new development unless it meaningfully improves quality of life and affordability
how_to_check: Watch how he votes on rezonings: kept if he votes against projects that do not deliver affordability or community benefits.

promise: Speed up the Pioneer Way supportive housing project.
quote: Expedite the Pioneer Way supportive housing project to create more permanent deeply affordable housing for those facing homelessness
how_to_check: Kept if council moves the Pioneer Way supportive housing forward (approvals, land, permits) and it gets built sooner.

promise: Raise the share of affordable homes developers must hand over to the District.
quote: Increase the proportion of affordable units that developers must provide to the DOS.
how_to_check: Kept if council adopts a policy or bylaw that requires a bigger share of affordable units in new developments.

promise: Set up formal shared decision making with the Squamish Nation on land use.
quote: As Mayor, I want to go beyond consultation to genuine, formalized shared decision-making on land use and environmental stewardship
how_to_check: Kept if the District and the Squamish Nation sign a formal agreement for shared decisions on land use or the environment.

promise: Pick a location for a downtown parkade.
quote: Identifying a location for a parkade.
how_to_check: Kept if council chooses or reserves a site for a downtown parkade during this term.

promise: Stop letting new buildings get approved with less parking than the rules require.
quote: Placing a moratorium on parking variances, so developers provide enough parking for their buildings.
how_to_check: Kept if council adopts a pause on parking variances, or he votes against every request to cut required parking.

promise: Negotiate with Woodfibre LNG for a new recreation centre with a pool and ice rink.
quote: Negotiate with Woodfibre LNG for a new recreation centre with an ice rink and pool
how_to_check: Kept if a new agreement with Woodfibre LNG includes money or a commitment for a new recreation centre with a pool and ice.

promise: Hold property taxes flat in 2027, with no increase.
quote: Freeze property taxes for 2027
how_to_check: Kept if the 2027 budget council adopts has a 0% municipal property tax increase; broken if it goes up.

promise: Pause new bike lane and sidewalk upgrades until residents have been properly consulted.
quote: Placing a moratorium on active transportation upgrades until more effective community engagement has taken place.
how_to_check: Kept if council pauses new active transportation projects until a public engagement process is done.

promise: Work with BC Transit and the province for an express highway bus every 15 minutes.
quote: Partnering with BC Transit and the provincial government to establish an express bus down the highway every 15 minutes, making transit a more practical option
how_to_check: Kept if the District formally asks for and works with BC Transit and the province on frequent express regional bus service.

promise: Rebuild the District's economic development department.
quote: Rebuild and strengthen the Economic Development Department.
how_to_check: Kept if council adds staff or money to economic development in the budget.

promise: Create a full Tourism Master Plan.
quote: Develop a comprehensive Tourism Master Plan (TMP) to strategically manage and grow Squamish's visitor economy.
how_to_check: Kept if council adopts a Tourism Master Plan during this term.

promise: Keep the growth boundary where it is until the neighbourhoods already planned are built.
quote: In my opinion, as a community we should be honouring the current boundary until the existing neighbourhoods are built out.
how_to_check: Broken if he votes to expand the growth boundary for housing before areas like Oceanfront are built out.

promise: Speed up an updated Official Community Plan.
quote: Fast-track an updated Official Community Plan (OCP) — Squamish needs a clear VISION.
how_to_check: Kept if council starts the Official Community Plan update early in the term and adopts it on a short timeline.

promise: Run a wide search for a new Chief Administrative Officer.
quote: Conduct a broad search for a new Chief Administrative Officer (CAO), Council's only employee.
how_to_check: Kept if council hires a new Chief Administrative Officer through an open, wide search.

promise: Bring in real performance reviews for the District's top managers.
quote: Introduce meaningful performance reviews for senior management and District leadership.
how_to_check: Kept if council sets up regular performance reviews for the Chief Administrative Officer and senior staff.

promise: Work with the RCMP on a new downtown safety plan.
quote: Work alongside the RCMP to develop and implement a new downtown safety strategy.
how_to_check: Kept if the District and RCMP adopt and carry out a new downtown safety strategy.

promise: Push for a new community centre, using provincial and federal money.
quote: Advocate for a new community centre that meets Squamish's growing needs.
how_to_check: Kept if he votes to plan a new community centre and the District applies for provincial and federal money for it.

promise: Bring back a grant writer to win provincial and federal money.
quote: Re-establish a grant writer to work on funding from provincial and federal sources.
how_to_check: Kept if the budget funds a District grant writer position.
